newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade at standstill -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle trade at standstill -USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers at a typical Monday standstill, USDA said.
Buyer inquiry good, and 110.00 a usual bid. Seller interest light, as most pricing stock from 111.00 to 112.00. Last price test of substance Friday at 110.00.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights )

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - few loads 109.00-110.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs - few loads 109.00-110.00. Confirmed - 300 Last Week - 100 Last Year - 400 For week - 3,700 Sm Pd Lst Wk - 8,900 Sm Pd Lst Yr - 400
